L2.name: 可替换视觉引擎层 (Substitutable Expression Engines)

L4.name: 治理、交付载体与转交层 (Governance & Handoff)

expression_engines.description: Select 1-3 expression engines native to the brand's habitat; swap freely instead of forcing every brand into a mascot or static pattern.

digital_product_track.description: Swap generic Web/Product UI (b17) with full AI SaaS Trust & Runtime modules (c1-c14) when AI capabilities are core.

fulfillment_tiers.full-auto: AI generative + deterministic SVG/HTML/PDF/Token pipeline can deliver 100% turnkey production artifacts.
fulfillment_tiers.visual-ready-handoff: Pipeline delivers ~80% visual artwork, layout specs, and photoreal mockups; final manufacturing needs supplier dielines, physical dimensions, or press proofs.
fulfillment_tiers.external-specialist: Requires legal, trademark, architectural/engineering, commercial font/music licensing, or certified audit sign-off; pipeline delivers formal briefs and acceptance criteria.
